dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why aren't you home on leave, then?

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: There's no need for me to. If I go back to Nasha Town, I'll just be hearing that old fool go on and on about how I shouldn't have joined the Lightkeepers or followed in their footsteps.

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: Hell, it was he and Uncle Sigurd who saved me back then, and it was he, Chicherin the Ratnik, who adopted me and taught me how to fight. And now he's also the one who won't stop nagging me...

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: Never mind. He might be terrified of the Wild Hunt, but not me. And he might have turned his back on the hero he once was, but I won't bring further dishonor to his name.

dialogues.speaker: Malusha
dialogues.text: Besides, it's probably better if I act on my own. I won't have to deal with military orders or worry about my teammates' safety, and I can focus on getting rid of those blasted monsters.
